name: set_text_window_open_transition

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_SetTextWindowOpenTransition consumes a window ID and preset index and stores it at window descriptor +0x0C; func_0010BB50 maps that preset through D_002B2D10 to the opening countdown, and func_0010B810 branches on it while opening the window

notes: Known preset indices 0 through 3 select opening countdowns of 0, 6, 9, and 20 ticks.
